privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains which data MySky uses, where it is kept and what you can do with it. It applies to the MySky app on iPhone and Android.
privacy.openHint: What MySky does with your data

who.title: Who publishes MySky
who.body:
MySky is an organisation app for pupils and students, published by {{publisher}}, in Cameroon. {{publisher}} is the controller of the data linked to MySky accounts.

For any question about this policy or your data, write to: {{email}}

summary.title: In short
summary.body:
• Without an account, your data stays only on your phone: we receive none of it.
• An account is optional. If you create one, your data is also copied to the MySky server so it syncs between your devices.
• No ads, no analytics, no tracking.
• Nothing is sold or shared for commercial purposes.
• You can delete everything at any time from the app, account included.

data.title: The data you enter

permissions.title: Phone permissions
permissions.body:
MySky asks for a permission only when you need it. Each one is optional:

• Notifications: for your reminders. They are scheduled by the phone itself, without going through the internet.
• Photos and camera: to attach a picture to a note, pick your profile photo or take your sport progress photos. Only the pictures you choose are copied into the app.
• Files: to attach a document or restore a backup.
• Face ID, Touch ID or passcode: only if you turn on the app lock. The check is done by the phone; MySky only receives “succeeded” or “failed”, never your face or fingerprint.

You can withdraw a permission at any time in your phone settings.

leaves.title: What can leave your phone
leaves.body:
Nothing leaves your phone unless you do it:

• Account: if you sign in, your data is synced with the MySky server (see below).
• Sharing: when you share a backup, a note as PDF or your calendar (.ics), you choose the recipient (email, messaging, Files…). That service then applies its own rules. A backup contains all your data in plain form: only send it somewhere you trust.
• Phone backup: on iPhone, if iCloud backup is on, Apple may include MySky's data in your device backup, linked to your Apple account. On Android, automatic backup is turned off for MySky.

visible.title: Widgets, notifications and lock screen
visible.body: If you add a MySky widget, it shows information (classes, tasks, exams, habits, average, money) on your home screen or lock screen: anyone who sees your phone can read it. Widgets and notifications never show the content of your notes or the reasons for missed habits, only titles, times and rooms.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
retention.body:
Your data is kept as long as you keep it. MySky makes a local backup every day and keeps the last 7.

• You can delete each item from the app.
• Settings › My data › “Delete all my data” erases everything: the database, attachments, backups and scheduled reminders.
• Uninstalling MySky also erases its data from the phone (except a possible iCloud backup of your device).
• Account › “Delete my account” deletes your account and all your data from the server, files included, then from the phone. Otherwise, an account's data is kept as long as the account exists.

security.title: Security
security.body: On the phone, your data is in the app's private space, and your sign-in session is kept in the phone's secure keychain. With an account, exchanges with the server are encrypted (HTTPS) and each account can only read its own data (security rules enforced by the database itself). Your password is never stored in plain text. You can add a Face ID, Touch ID or passcode lock in Settings › Privacy. Also protect your phone with a passcode: it is the first protection of your data.

minors.title: Minors
minors.body: MySky can be used by pupils under the age of majority, with or without an account. If you are a minor, ask your parents or legal guardian before creating an account, and talk to them about your use of MySky.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body:
Cameroon's Law No. 2024/017 of 23 December 2024 on the protection of personal data gives you in particular the rights to information, access, rectification, erasure, portability and objection.

In MySky you exercise these rights yourself, directly in the app: you view and edit your data, delete it (account included), and export it (backup, note as PDF, .ics calendar). For your account data you can also write to us: we answer within one month.

For any question: {{email}}. You can also contact the Personal Data Protection Authority provided for by that law. If you live in another country, you also keep the rights given by your country's law (for example the GDPR in the European Union).

account.title: Account and sync
account.body:
An account is optional. You can create it with your email address and a password, or with Apple or Google.

• Account data: your email address, your first and last name if you give them, and, with Apple or Google, the identifier that service sends us. Apple and Google receive none of your MySky data.
• Synced data: everything you enter in the app (see “The data you enter”), including your attachments and profile photo.
• Why: only to sign you in and let you find your data on your devices. Legal basis: your consent, given when you create the account, which you can withdraw by deleting the account.
• Where: with our host Supabase, in the {{region}} region. Data may therefore be hosted outside Cameroon; this transfer is made within the framework of Law No. 2024/017.
• Who can access it: only you, from the app. The host acts on our behalf and does not use your data for itself. We only access it when needed to answer your request or a legal obligation.
• Signing out: you choose to keep or erase the phone's copy; the data stays on your account.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: The date of the last update is shown at the top. If this policy changes in an important way, you will be told in the app.
